scenarios.name: raw SOL deposit
scenarios.evidence: The public interface codec and deposit builder reproduce every frozen account flag and byte.

scenarios.name: registered private transfer
scenarios.evidence: Three frozen rail cases reproduce public transact instructions and legacy unsigned messages exactly.

scenarios.name: SOL withdrawal
scenarios.evidence: The public codec and builder reproduce the signed amount, settlement accounts, proof payload, message, output state, and recipient delta.

scenarios.name: SPL withdrawal
scenarios.evidence: The public codec and builder reproduce the mixed-input proof, SPL CPI suffix, message, output state, and recipient delta.

scenarios.name: proof rails and ordering
scenarios.evidence: EdDSA omits BSB22 commitment fields; P256 and mixed P256 carry them. Every prover input count equals its ordered spend-proof count.

scenarios.name: direct and inner confirmation
scenarios.evidence: All direct and inner output-tag vectors match exactly, including owner-tag resolution failures.

scenarios.name: external signing
scenarios.evidence: Native external signing preserves exact frozen unsigned message bytes and fills the required signature slot.

scenarios.name: negative acceptance
scenarios.evidence: Malformed data, account reordering, incomplete and malformed proofs, wrong signatures and tags, replay, abort, timeout, and live malformed-account rejection retain exact typed evidence.
